name: terminals
description: Seven small verbs that turn a messy idea-pile into a coherent answer with a checkable receipt, then act on it and keep it true. Convergence math (the 7-grid, the lock-in, done=true) wired to a live sure-o-meter. Plus the Terminals ontology — one externally-gated interaction-arrow weighted by coherence R, the nine constructed objects, and the ontological functions. Ships as commands, skills, and an MCP tool.
